question: Does the backdoor jump require both components - the mapping machine built by normal learning and the trigger bias seeded by poisoned rows - or does either alone carry it (additive)?

materials.W_fork: saved fork-point adapter of the 2026-10-13 fork experiment

machine_states.tj: B2 continuation (no poison after fork) replayed to t_jump

materials.bias_increment: W_mother(t_jump) - W_B2(t_jump): same start, same clean stream, differs only by the decisive poisoned rows and what they caused
materials.control: Gaussian direction with the same global norm as the bias increment, alphas 1 and 2 on the tj40 machine; generator seed 73001 + mother seed
materials.replay_receipt: B0 replay to t_jump must reproduce the mother's recorded adapter sha256; otherwise engineering failure

classes.multiplicative: hits(fork, a=2) <= 3 and hits(tj40, a=0.5) >= 30 and hits(tj40, a=0) <= 3 and both random controls <= 3
classes.additive: hits(fork, a=2) >= 30, or |hits(fork, a=1) - hits(tj40, a=1)| <= 10
classes.not_specific: a random direction of the same norm on tj40 gives > 3 hits
classes.tier: all three mothers in the same class, else 'inconsistent'

preregistered_prediction.detail: bias x2 on the immature fork machine stays <= 3; bias x0.5 on the tj40 machine already installs; the end machine installs with even less; random directions do nothing
preregistered_prediction.basis: A'/A'2 (clean data drives >80% of the displacement in the jump window), B2 (no poison -> no jump but transient margin rise), poison push along the final direction peaks at mid loss; all guesses

scope_limits: synthetic weights, not states reached by training
one model, one dose, three mothers
results that contradict the prediction do not change the classes

budget.reference_estimate_not_cap: states ~15 min per mother (B2 100 updates + B0 to t_jump), grid ~10 min per mother (19 evaluations); about 1.5 GPU hours
